name: Vandana Knitwear Limited
summary: Vandana Knitwear Limited operates as a textile enterprise, primarily focusing on the production and commercial distribution of a diverse range of textile items. Their product line features hosiery such as socks, various articles of clothing like shirts and sweaters, and general garments and fabrics. The company was established on March 22, 1995, and its main office is situated in Mumbai, India.
